entries.en: So whass good? Got any plans this weekend?
entries.ro: Deci ce mai e nou? Ai planuri weekendul ăsta?

entries.en: Nah, just chillin' at home. Gettin' some new anti-burglary shutters put in.
entries.ro: Nah, chill acasă. Îmi montez niște obloane noi anti-spargere.

entries.en: No shit. How much they set you back? Was thinkin' of gettin' some myself.
entries.ro: Pe bune? Cât te-au costat? Mă gândeam să-mi iau și eu.

entries.en: More than you'd think. But if I was countin' every enny, I'd end up like my next-door neighbor. Chowin' down worms.
entries.ro: Mai mult decât crezi. Dar dacă număr fiecare enny, ajung ca vecinul de alături. Mănâncă viermi acum.
